text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I didn't end up running the way I wanted to last time, but… this time…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With all these earnest Umamusume in the race, I have to be serious about winning too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It would be disrespectful to them if I don't show that I learned from my mistake!
choice_data_list: That's a good way to look at it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Right? Like, maybe my running can help draw out the fight in my oshis!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The more passionate I run, the more driven they'll be—and the more I'll see them sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's essentially a feedback loop! My never-ending love generates their fanservice! I'm gonna put my whole heart into this race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't completely follow, but it seems like Agnes Digital is nice and motivated!
